# MAZ-543 / MAZ-543A visual reference set

Research date: 2026-09-05. All seven listed local images were downloaded and visually inspected with view_image. Only vehicle cab/chassis features are relevant; installed equipment visible in museum photographs is outside the modeling reference scope.

## Preferred coherent version

Use the MAZ-543A factory photograph with museum front and cab details as the clearest coherent visual family. The earliest MAZ-543 prototype photograph is a separate version, not an interchangeable source for the engine housing or window detailing. MAZ-543M has one left cab and must not supply the overall body layout.

## Checked candidates

1. **museum-front.jpg** — 1415 × 1130. Almost square front view, Ukraine Strategic Missile Forces Museum. Commons caption explicitly identifies MAZ-543A. Strong reference for separated cabs, sloping inside lower corners of windscreens, rounded thick rubber frames, low central radiator grille, lamps, bumper width and front tire track.
   - Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MAZ-543_special_purpose_truck,_Strategic_Missile_Forces_Museum.JPG
   - Direct: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f7/MAZ-543_special_purpose_truck%2C_Strategic_Missile_Forces_Museum.JPG
   - Photographer: Vladimir Zinin. CC BY-SA 3.0 as stated on the source page.

2. **museum-front-oblique.jpg** — 1067 × 1600. Despite the local filename, this is principally a left cab side close-up with front wheel. Museum source labels the MAZ-543 family; likely the same 543A equipment family, but the page itself does not specify A. Excellent for two tandem doors per cab, small forward trapezoid side pane, curved roof edge, rivets, door seams, stirrup step, tire shoulder and wheel hub. The door window panels are folded outward/down in the photograph: do not model these as two fixed rows of windows.
   - Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MAZ-543_special_purpose_truck.JPG
   - Direct: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b0/MAZ-543_special_purpose_truck.JPG
   - Photographer: Michael. CC BY 3.0 as stated on the source page.

3. **factory-543a-profile.jpg** — 880 × 495. Front-left three-quarter, bare chassis. The author caption attributes this to the MAZ SKB-1 archive and explicitly identifies serial MAZ-543A. Strongest bare-chassis version anchor. Cab rear meets roughly the leading region of the first wheel, compact engine compartment occupies the first two axle area, long exposed rear frame.
   - Source: https://www.kolesa.ru/article/kolesa-kompleksa-s-300-maz-543-luchshij-chetyrehosnyj-avtomobil-sovetskoj-armii
   - Direct: https://kolesa-uploads.ru/r/880x/c3989efe-4d99-4c3f-8ce9-c43022b1229e/original-19-543-html-m44df2dbf.jpg
   - Caption: Serial MAZ-543A chassis, assembly-frame length greater than 7 m; MAZ SKB-1 archive.

4. **maz543a-4.jpg** — 800 × 398. Front-right three-quarter bare chassis. Source explicitly labels MAZ-543A and credits Michal Pertzian's collection. Visually coherent with factory-543a-profile.jpg. Useful for right-cab shape, nose projection, first tire relation, rounded window openings, engine compartment louvers and open axle gaps.
   - Source: https://xn----7sbb5ahj4aiadq2m.xn--p1ai/guide/army/tr/maz543.shtml
   - Direct: https://xn----7sbb5ahj4aiadq2m.xn--p1ai/guide/army/tr/maz543a-4.jpg

5. **maz543a-5.jpg** — 613 × 602. Elevated rear-left three-quarter bare chassis. Source explicitly labels MAZ-543A and credits autocity21.ru; image itself bears that watermark. Strong reference for paired longitudinal frame rails, crossmembers, driveline central housings, pipe runs, rear beam, tire staggered blocks and broad sidewalls. It has no vehicle serial plate visible, so exact production year is unknown.
   - Source: https://xn----7sbb5ahj4aiadq2m.xn--p1ai/guide/army/tr/maz543.shtml

6. **original-543-prototype.jpg** — 880 × 495. Early MAZ-543 prototype, front-right near-side perspective. Caption explicitly attributes it to the NIITs AT archive. Useful only if earliest prototype is intended: longer, lower engine enclosure; larger and squarer door glass; different door hardware. Do not combine this old engine enclosure with the 543A cab placement.

7. **maz543-1.gif** — 800 × 275. Dimensioned side/front line drawing, source caption labels MAZ-543 and credits vpauto.ru. Not established as a factory drawing. Readable labels: front overhang 2540 mm, axle intervals 2200 + 3300 + 2200 mm, overall length 11240 mm, width 3070 mm, track 2375 mm, height 2900 mm, clearance 400 mm, rear mounting portion 6130 mm. Rear overhang is 1000 mm by subtraction. Useful for asymmetrical front/rear overhang and cab-to-first-wheel relationship, not authoritative precision.
   - Source: https://xn----7sbb5ahj4aiadq2m.xn--p1ai/guide/army/tr/maz543.shtml

## Dimension evidence and limits

- The 1977 official technical manual is the preferred authority: https://djvu.online/file/zjMdLY3MFjmTL . Its indexed text was read, but the original page scan/image and download could not be obtained here. It explicitly says MAZ-543 and MAZ-543A have two two-seat, two-door cabs, with seats one behind the other; 543V and 543M have a single left cab. The dimensional OCR is column-disordered and must not be assigned to a variant from search snippets alone.
- E. Kochnev's historical book excerpt gives MAZ-543 front overhang 2540 mm and total 11240 mm: https://tech.wikireading.ru/1076 . For 543A it gives front overhang 2633 mm, mounting length 7070 mm and total 11470 mm: https://tech.wikireading.ru/1077 . These are secondary historical values, not an inspected factory dimensional drawing. They imply 1137 mm rear overhang for A, using the 7700 mm axle spread. Keep this uncertainty visible if selecting exact dimensions.
- Equal front and rear overhangs are visually incompatible with every checked bare-chassis photograph. With the four axle centers at -3.85, -1.65, +1.65, +3.85 m, a base 543 using the dimensioned drawing has front end at -6.39 m and rear at +4.85 m (front toward negative X). Cab/rear chassis must not be centered merely by averaging the axles.
- maz543a-7.jpg was downloaded and inspected but excluded from the preferred set: the web page calls it MAZ-543A while the image itself prints MZKT-543. It is a later brochure image and is not sufficiently definite for an early-model baseline.
- maz543-6.jpg is a small 391 × 253 base-MAZ-543 image and is superseded by the clearer references above.

## Shape notes for Blender

- The two cabs are narrow independent pods. Their front glass is a rounded polygon, with a pronounced diagonal lower inner corner, not a generic rectangle.
- A narrow forward side pane follows the front face around the outer corner, ahead of the two door windows.
- Roof and shell have shallow molded curvature and soft perimeter transitions; the silhouette still has deliberate flat facets and a cut lower nose corner. Avoid both a perfect box and an overly bulbous cartoon shell.
- Front radiator grille top is far below cab roof; it has its own frame and a shallow hinged top surface.
- First axle is behind most of each cab. The step hangs below the doors in front of the wheel.
- Tire sidewalls are broad and slightly inflated with a rounded shoulder, staggered thick tread blocks, and a recessed wheel face around a projecting central hub. The rear elevated photo shows how the tread wraps onto the shoulders.

## Additional verified scale sources

### Tire size (product specification, not a 1977 fitment claim)

A BELSHINA-branded VI-203 single-page product sheet was downloaded from a dealer, rendered with Poppler and visually checked. Local files: VI-203-manufacturer-sheet.pdf and VI-203-manufacturer-sheet.png. The page is legible for its entire specification table; some upper descriptive text is clipped in the source itself. No editing of the source PDF was done.

- Product/source page: https://rtyre.ru/store/gruzovyebr-shiny/1500h600-635-vi-203-belshina/
- Direct PDF: https://rtyre.ru/uploads/booklets/Vi-203.pdf
- Model and marking: VI-203 / ВИ-203, 1500x600-635.
- Outside diameter: 1500 mm; section width: 610 mm; rim: 500-635; tread depth: 25 mm; tube-type TT.
- Practical modeling size: radius 0.750 m and maximum section width about 0.610 m. The nominal bead-seat diameter is 0.635 m; this is not the outside diameter of the visible complete hub/rim assembly.
- This confirms the VI-203 product dimensions. It does not establish original factory fitment on a 1960s or 1977 example, and the early B-77 tread should not be silently replaced with VI-203 if a specific early-production vehicle is chosen.

### Engine original-manufacturer dimensions

Manufacturer Barnaultransmash explicitly lists D12A-525A for MAZ-543, MAZ-7310 and MAZ-74106.

- Source: https://www.barnaultransmash.ru/d12a-525a
- D12A-525A / Д12А-525А: length 1575 mm, width 1052 mm, height 1070 mm, mass 1540 kg.
- 525 hp at 2000 rpm; V12 with 60-degree banks; liquid cooling; dry-sump lubrication.
- These are engine product dimensions, not the external engine compartment including radiators, tanks and service clearance. The similarly named D12A-525 without the final A has other dimensions in supplier listings and must not be substituted.
